text: It is only in the soil of incessant activity and exertion that the germ will thrive, but also only in the sunshine of victory. Once it becomes a strong tree, it will stand against the fiercest storms of misfortune and defeat, and even against the indolent inactivity of peace, at least for a time.
author: Carl von Clausewitz
locator: Book III, Chapter V, Military Virtue of an Army
